name: R&K (Rookie & King)
source: v7.1 (8 Nov 2026): rook + king mark from Dave's own R&Klogo.ai, Night #020617 backgrounds. Core colours sampled from his file: artboard #06133F, blue rgb(31,91,255), white; Ice, Deep Blue and Graphite from his gradient stops.
meaning: His palette leads: Navy, Electric Blue, White. Cool tones (Steel, Mist) carry cold, waiting and status. Warm Win Amber appears only for the win: the handshake, the connection, the level-up. Never in the logo.

palette.name: Navy
palette.role: Dave's artboard. Base canvas, the board's frame

palette.name: Electric Blue
palette.role: The Rookie half, ROOKIE, primary actions (white text 5.25:1)

palette.name: White
palette.role: The King half, & KING, text on dark (17.9:1 on Navy)

palette.name: Ice
palette.role: Dave's highlight on the rook: glints, focus, light-square edge (10.7:1 on Navy)

palette.name: Deep Blue
palette.role: Dave's pawn shadow: pressed states, blue depth

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Dave's king shadow: piece shading only, never text

palette.name: Night
palette.role: Logo backgrounds, app icon, board frame, page canvas. Near-black navy so blue and white pop (Electric Blue 3.8:1, White 20.2:1)

palette.name: Raised
palette.role: Raised cards, hover, light squares (with blue)

palette.name: Sky
palette.role: Links, info, move hints on Navy (5.36:1)

palette.name: Steel
palette.role: Cold and neutral: cold outreach, waiting, labels (6.3:1 on Navy)

palette.name: Win Amber
palette.role: The win only: the handshake, the connection, level up (8.3:1 on Navy; Navy text on it 8.3:1)

palette.name: Amber Deep
palette.role: Amber on light backgrounds (5.0:1 on white)

palette.name: Alert
palette.role: Errors only, always with an icon and a word (6.0:1 on Navy)

type.display: Poppins 800-900 (closest Google font to Dave's wordmark); headlines sentence case, -0.02em
type.interface: Inter 400-600; labels Inter 600 caps .16em; numbers tabular

icons: solid silhouettes, 24 grid, 2px knockouts, 2.5 corner radius, currentColor; Rookie/King/Connect use Dave's own vectors
